title: Erdős–Gyárfás conjecture: calibrated SAT-modulo-symmetries verification for cubic graphs on at most 40 vertices
description: Code, data and logs for the computational result: every connected cubic graph on at most 40 vertices contains a cycle of length 4, 8 or 16; consequently a smallest cubic counterexample to the Erdős–Gyárfás conjecture has at least 42 vertices. SAT modulo symmetries with a Glasgow subgraph-solver propagator, calibrated against thirteen exhaustive reference censuses (nine nonzero, up to 52781 C16-free cubic graphs at order 22), with set-level comparison against independent enumeration, a totalizer re-decision of the headline order, and positive controls at and beyond the frontier. Includes the complete July 2026 independent enumeration apparatus (n=30, 348.7 core-hours) used as ground truth.
